ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) base with approximately 10-15% high-intensity (white) localized features and highlight clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity mapping across both lobes with high-contrast white circular focal spots distributed semi-randomly; dense clustering of high-intensity pixels observed at the extreme distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees; notch depth is deep relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extreme high-amplitude, high-frequency serrations at the distal tips; medial portions of the trailing edge exhibit lower-frequency, jagged undulating peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave leading edge trajectory; trailing edges exhibit a jagged, non-linear convex sweep toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive detection of circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (2-15 pixel diameter) scattered across both lobes, with high-density aggregation on the distal margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the medial-to-lateral section of the left lobe, oriented roughly perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular structural protrusions and erosion on the distal tips of both lobes; visible raised vertical textural anomaly at the base of the fluke where it joins the peduncle.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, three-dimensional knobby silhouette on the trailing edge tips caused by high-contrast pixel clusters protruding from the primary fluke geometry.
